name: tsernc
// packageManager: Here we define the package manager name and version which will be used in the project
// workspaces: This field define a monorepo structure multiple package/apps in one repository that share dependencies

scripts.db:migrate: docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml exec api yarn workspace @repo/db db-migrate
scripts.db:seed: docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml exec api yarn workspace @repo/db db-seed
scripts.db:generate: docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml exec api yarn workspace @repo/db db-generate
scripts.db:reset: docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml exec api yarn workspace @repo/db db-reset
